unit_tests.scope: Synthetic disposable fixtures exercise harness behavior; no mathematical proof claim.

frozen_inputs.authentication: unsigned local commitment; retain independently from mutable inputs

negative_controls.scope: Exact source-hash-identical fixtures; cached-project compilation context. Fresh project-source replay belongs to parent workflow.

actual_lean_smoke.scope: 2 modules,2 roots,1 negative; not whole report replay

recommendations.implementation: Unique run/status/completion identity; stale success does not become current success.
Exact nonempty source coverage and separately supplied manifest digest.
Normal exit 1 and one target-specific structured diagnostic.
Exact nine locked packages, clean tracked sources, cache hashes and no shadowed modules.
Resume context, source, command/options, log/object and full attempt inventory validation.
Fresh output tree per nonresume run; import-topological local compilation.
Started/final attempt states, timeout/signal receipts, charged CPU/wall/RSS, Linux descendant cleanup.
Fsynced immutable attempt records and atomic status/event writes; old runs retained.
Generic separately pinned complete-release byte cross-check utility; parent release manifest pending.
Structured warnings/options/source directives and measured CPU/RSS/elapsed time; defined resource scope.

assurance_limits: Unsigned local commitments are not authenticated origin.
Cached dependency bytes and Git revision match are not a source-rebuild provenance proof.
Privileged transient change-and-restore writers are outside the integrity boundary.
SIGKILL can leave a retained unfinalized receipt; automatic resume then fails closed.
Log ceiling polling may overshoot; escaped process descendants are outside process-group containment.
The complete report was not replayed by this new standalone harness.
Final delivered release record requires parent packaging and cross-check.
